visual_brief.subject: Small freelance tasks reorganize into broader, bundled AI-related projects
verified_context: OpenAI and Upwork report that 43 of 63 analyzed work categories shifted in the expected opposite direction from common ChatGPT activity.
AI-related freelance projects combined more skills and carried larger budgets and more work in the observed sample.
The platform study is observational and does not prove causal or economy-wide employment effects.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Fragmented work pieces combine into fewer substantial project blocks without implying a numerical trend line.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Loose charcoal, sage and terracotta paper fragments flow into three large layered project stacks.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. The fragments and three substantial stacks communicate project bundling without people, labels or an invented chart.
candidate_notes.B: Rejected at the constitutional gate because gear, play and code-like symbols read as a presentation icon system.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant, but the storage-box metaphor suggests filing rather than changes in project scope.

crop_review.article_desktop: The complete metaphor and separation boundaries remain visible in the wide 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the dominant chamber, gate or transformation and its terracotta signal.
crop_review.thumbnail: The physical silhouette remains distinct at 320px without relying on fine texture.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate matches the golden references in warm paper field, restrained charcoal/teal mass, sparse terracotta signal, tactile materiality and confident negative space while keeping a story-specific silhouette.
